name: Plan spinner
summary: Three tapes pick an activity, food and an after plan the chat didn't veto, then people RSVP until it locks.
useWhen: a group can't pick weekend plans: 'idk anything', 'you pick'
a few ideas per part of the day, some ruled out in the chat
dontUseWhen: one question to vote on (use a poll)
the plan is already set (use an RSVP)
tonight's bar run with drink prices (use slot-machine)
